PROJECT PLANNING

From Your Brief to Sample Approval

01

Share your requirements

Start with your product and the experience you want to create.

What to confirm
  • Product dimensions and weight
  • Preferred structure and quantity
  • Logo or artwork references
  • Color, finish and delivery needs
02

Review design & quotation

Bring the structure, materials and finishing into a clear written specification.

What to confirm
  • Box layout and opening direction
  • Paper and insert options
  • Artwork and finishing scope
  • Project-specific price and schedule
03

Approve a physical sample

Check the presentation with the actual product before production approval.

What to confirm
  • Fit and internal clearance
  • Paper texture and printed color
  • Closure and opening experience
  • Signed-off final specification
04

Production & delivery

Agree on the production checkpoints, packing method and delivery arrangement.

What to confirm
  • Production schedule
  • Inspection checkpoints
  • Outer carton packing
  • Freight plan and destination
COMMON QUESTIONS

Ramadan & Eid Packaging FAQ

Minimum quantities depend on the box format, dimensions, paper and finishing method. Tell us your expected quantity so the specification and order requirements can be reviewed together.

The schedule depends on sampling, material availability, finishing and quantity. Confirm the sample approval date, production window and shipping plan in the final quotation.

A physical sample helps confirm product fit, paper feel, opening behavior and print. Agree on sampling scope, cost and timing before proceeding.

Share your logo files, color references and preferred artwork. A physical proof or approved sample should be used as the final production reference.

Foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, soft-touch lamination and textured papers are possible directions. The appropriate process is confirmed for your chosen material and artwork.
